# Prebuilt PJRT CPU plugin assets, one row per (release, platform).
#
#   <release-tag>  <os-arch>  <url>  <sha256>
#
# Regenerated by tools/release_plugin.sh --update-manifest after a release is
# published; the diff is reviewed and committed by hand. Read by
# tools/get_plugin.sh and cmake/GetPjrtPlugin.cmake.
#
# linux-x86_64 is published for both tags. linux-aarch64 is published for
# neither: on that platform `make plugin` prints the remedies and
# `make plugin-source` builds from the fork. Either producer may add the
# missing architecture to a tag later. See docs/developer/release-process.md.
